responsibility: This definition file is the canonical list of AArch64 ISA runtime-state modes that affect instruction availability or semantics independently of the architectural feature mask. It currently names compile-time knowledge about SME state such as `PSTATE.SM` being on or off and `PSTATE.ZA` being enabled, allowing surrounding backend code to generate enums, masks, and mode-tracking logic for streaming-mode and ZA-sensitive code generation from a single table.
